name: RideNow
tagline: Ride-hailing for one city: rider app, driver app, live dispatch, wallet and payouts.
description: Draft (not yet listed). A complete ride-hailing product for Bengaluru: riders book with upfront fares, surge and promo codes, and track the car live; drivers go online, accept offers, verify the rider's PIN and get paid into a wallet they can withdraw from. Dispatch offers each ride to the nearest drivers in turn, and simulated demo drivers complete rides on their own so one person can see the whole flow. The operations app arrives in R-530, before the template is published.

roles.name: Rider
roles.description: Books rides, pays by wallet or cash, rates drivers.

roles.name: Driver
roles.description: Goes online, accepts and completes rides, withdraws earnings.

roles.name: Operations
roles.description: Runs the city: drivers, pricing, refunds, payouts and support.

features: Upfront fares per vehicle type with surge and promo codes
Live dispatch with timed offers and re-dispatch
Live trip tracking over server-sent events
Wallet with card top-up, cash trips and commission
